skill.name: frontend-design
skill.description: Create distinctive, production-grade frontend interfaces with high design quality. Use this skill for web components, pages, and applications.
skill.summary: Guide AI agents to build polished, distinctive, working frontend interfaces.
skill.author: am-will

finding_verdicts.reason: The line describes frontend aesthetic goals and implementing working code, not host or environment discovery. It contains no commands, system probing instructions, or data collection intent.

content.value_statement: Generic frontend drafts can look repetitive and disconnected from user context. This skill guides Claude, Codex, and Claude Code to build polished interfaces with a clear visual direction.
actual_capabilities: Guides aesthetic direction before frontend implementation begins.
Supports component, page, application, and interface design requests.
Encourages distinctive typography, color, motion, composition, and background detail.
Discourages generic AI design patterns and repetitive visual choices.
Prompts working implementations in common frontend stacks when available.
Aligns implementation complexity with the selected visual direction.
limitations: Does not include reusable component code or bundled visual assets.
Does not test accessibility, responsiveness, or performance by itself.
Depends on the host agent and project tooling to implement code.
May need clear constraints to avoid overly elaborate visuals.

use_cases.title: Design a Product Interface
use_cases.description: Create a polished dashboard, tool, or workflow screen with a clear visual direction.

use_cases.title: Build a Marketing Page
use_cases.description: Turn a product brief into a distinctive page that avoids common AI design patterns.

use_cases.title: Improve App Screens
use_cases.description: Refine spacing, typography, motion, and layout in an existing frontend implementation.

prompt_templates.title: Beginner Interface Request
prompt_templates.scenario: Use when starting a simple page or component.
prompt_templates.prompt: Build a polished frontend for a project management dashboard. Choose a clear aesthetic direction and implement the main screen.

prompt_templates.title: Audience Focused Page
prompt_templates.scenario: Use when the interface must match a specific audience.
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a landing page for independent designers. Make the visual direction distinctive, refined, and suitable for creative professionals.

prompt_templates.title: Existing App Redesign
prompt_templates.scenario: Use when improving an existing frontend surface.
prompt_templates.prompt: Redesign this settings screen to feel more intentional. Improve hierarchy, spacing, typography, interaction states, and visual consistency.

prompt_templates.title: Advanced Design System Direction
prompt_templates.scenario: Use when a full visual language is needed.
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a frontend concept for an analytics app. Define the aesthetic direction, then implement layouts, states, motion, and reusable patterns.

output_examples.input: A SaaS dashboard needs a less generic first screen.
output_examples.output: A cohesive dashboard direction with distinctive typography, focused navigation, dense data areas, and purposeful interaction states.

output_examples.input: A portfolio page needs more personality without losing clarity.
output_examples.output: A refined page concept with stronger hierarchy, memorable visual details, responsive sections, and restrained motion.

output_examples.input: An app screen feels flat and unfinished.
output_examples.output: A sharper interface treatment with improved spacing, color contrast, visual rhythm, and component polish.

best_practices: Provide the audience, product purpose, and technical stack before requesting implementation.
Name any accessibility, performance, or brand constraints that must guide the design.
Ask for verification on real desktop and mobile viewports after implementation.
anti_patterns: Do not request a generic modern UI without product context.
Do not accept decorative effects that weaken readability or task completion.
Do not use this skill as a substitute for usability testing.

faq.question: What does this skill help create?
faq.answer: It helps create distinctive frontend components, pages, and app screens with polished visual direction.

faq.question: Which tools can use this skill?
faq.answer: The report lists support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.

faq.question: Does it generate complete applications?
faq.answer: It can guide complete interface builds, but the host agent and project tooling perform the implementation.

faq.question: Can it improve an existing design?
faq.answer: Yes. It can guide changes to typography, spacing, layout, motion, and visual detail.

faq.question: Does it include assets or fonts?
faq.answer: No. It provides design guidance and implementation direction, not packaged assets or licensed fonts.

faq.question: Is it safe to install?
faq.answer: The reviewed file contains design instructions only. No unsafe behavior was found in this audit.
